card.name: Dosage unit nouns after a count
card.fires_on: Plural unit nouns such as tablets, inhalations or cartridges right after a number word or strength (two, three 333 mg). Also fires on the end of some plural drug-class nouns like antihistamines.

modes.label: Dose units after number
